runtimes.title: Runtimes
runtimes.description: Verified, portable tools for your projects.

services.title: Services & logs
services.description: Shared database services and process output.
services.selectionHint: Stop the project before changing services. Project default keeps its own environment. Database drivers require the project’s Laravel tables.
services.redisHint: Each project has its own Garnet process. Managed .NET is downloaded separately. Cache uses DB 1; queues use DB 0.
services.predisHint: Redis-compatible drivers require Predis in the project. Install the client before saving Redis settings.
services.backupHint: Managed PostgreSQL/MySQL only. Logical backup, up to 1 GiB and 5 minutes. Restore requires the same engine and version. MySQL supports InnoDB tables and data; views, triggers, routines and events are rejected. Archives contain sensitive data.
services.restoreHint: This archive can execute SQL as a project user. Only restore a trusted archive. A new database will be created; the current database and its credentials are retained. Stop external workers and close other database clients first.
services.switchHint: The selected database becomes active. The previous database and credentials are retained. Your .env file is unchanged. Stop external workers first.
services.operationFailed: The operation failed. Close this dialog to see the details and recovery action.
services.clientHint: Composer will add predis/predis to composer.json and composer.lock in this trusted project. Plugins and scripts are disabled. Review and commit those project changes.
services.fileError: The file dialog could not be opened. Retry the archive action.
services.restoreSummary: Restore creates a new database and keeps the previous data.
services.retainedHint: Reactivate a previous connection without copying or deleting its data.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.description: Requests, queries, jobs and dumps from your local projects.
inspector.name: Name
inspector.setupHint: Install the local Laravel companion, then enable capture.
inspector.waitHint: Open a page or dispatch a job in this project to capture events.
inspector.enableHint: Enable capture to inspect this project.
inspector.localHint: Opt-in for local/testing projects. No request bodies, headers or SQL bindings. Capture ends when DevForge quits; re-enable it after reopening.
inspector.retention: Latest 200 events within 24 hours · payload budget 16 MiB
inspector.selectEvent: Select an event to view its context.
inspector.heuristic: Repeated queries are a diagnostic hint, not proof of N+1. Values are redacted best-effort; use local test data.
inspector.truncated: This capture is incomplete; some context details may be missing.
inspector.probeHint: Check whether the selected PHP includes Xdebug.
inspector.xdebugPresent: Xdebug is loaded. Its current version/mode is shown; native debugger configuration is separate.
inspector.xdebugMissing: Xdebug is not loaded in this runtime. Request/SQL profiling works; function-level Xdebug control requires a compatible extension.
inspector.loadFailed: Could not load inspection data. Retry.
inspector.operationFailed: Inspector operation failed. Check runtime and project state.
inspector.installHint: Stop this project first. This adds .devforge/laravel-inspector, changes composer.json/composer.lock and vendor, and runs package:discover. Composer scripts/plugins are disabled during require. Only install into a trusted local project. No .env changes.
inspector.clearHint: Only Inspector history for this project is removed. Project files and databases remain unchanged.

activity.logsHint: Logs are opt-in. Capture package changes affect the project. Sensitive context keys are redacted; retention is bounded.
activity.failed: Could not load this activity. Retry or check that capture is running.
activity.remoteBlocked: Remote resources and links are blocked. Inline images are available as attachments.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Separate branches, local data and services.

forks.name: Workspace name
forks.committedOnly: Workspaces use committed Git history. Local changes stay in the source project.
forks.cleanupPreserves: Cleanup archives all local files and keeps the Git branch, database and credentials. Only this workspace is stopped and unregistered.
forks.emptyHelp: Create a workspace from a registered Git project to work on another branch independently.
forks.dependencies: Install Composer and npm dependencies without scripts or plugins
forks.copyEnvironment: Copy selected local environment secrets into new, independent secret entries
forks.newHelp: The source .env, vendor, uploads and node_modules are not copied. A new .env and application key are created. Database copy requires the source project to be stopped. Unmanaged database copies are not supported.
forks.environmentNotCopied: Not copied; configure secrets separately when needed.
forks.dirtySource: The source has local changes. Only the reviewed commit will be checked out.
forks.trust: I trust this repository and allow Git checkout and the selected dependency setup.
forks.created: Workspace created. Open its project to prepare or start services.
forks.archived: Workspace archived. Files, branch and databases are retained.
forks.localDataRetained: Project-local data remains in the archive.
forks.cleanupConsent: Stop and unregister this workspace, archive its files and retain its branch and database.
forks.externalTools: Close external tools using this workspace before archiving.
forks.restoreHelp: Restore files, the same project identity and retained local database. The reviewed branch must still match.
forks.purgeHelp: Permanently deletes this archive’s files, including ignored .env and SQLite files. Managed databases, credentials and branches remain. Isolated Git history is retained in recovery bundles.
forks.archiveConsent: I reviewed the archive and this action.
forks.submoduleClone: This repository uses submodules. DevForge creates a separate clone with recursive submodules, preserving Git metadata for archive and restore. Trust the listed sources and their nested modules.
forks.remoteHelp: Copy into this stopped workspace’s managed database. The source is read only; use a read-only account. Store its password reference for this project in Configuration. Remote hosts require a CA file and verified TLS.
forks.loopbackOnly: Allow unencrypted literal loopback only (127.0.0.1 or ::1)
forks.mysqlRemoteTables: MySQL copies tables and data. Triggers, routines and events are excluded. Review this scope before continuing.
forks.remoteConsent: I reviewed the source, trust its dump and want to activate its copy locally. Keep the previous local database.

debugger.title: Debugger & profiler
debugger.description: Project-scoped Xdebug sessions and function profiles.
debugger.emptyHelp: Register a Laravel project before enabling native debugging.
debugger.sourceHelp: Pause on a project frame to view nearby source lines.
debugger.stackEmpty: No paused stack. Run a request and continue to a breakpoint.
debugger.variablesEmpty: Variables appear when the engine reaches a PHP frame.
debugger.profileEmpty: Choose Profile mode, start the project and run a request.
debugger.truncated: Only the top500 functions are shown. Export the retained file for full analysis.

debugger.configureHelp: Stop this project before changing mode. The normal PHP selection remains unchanged. A matching managed runtime is used while Xdebug is enabled.
debugger.consent: Apply this mode only to the selected project.
debugger.buildHelp: macOS builds a matching CLI/FPM and Xdebug in a private prefix using Apple Command Line Tools. Windows downloads a matching official NTS DLL. Sources/checksums and build provenance are recorded. No global PHP, Homebrew or PECL installation is performed. Initial preparation may take several minutes; completed runtimes are reused.
debugger.trustBuild: Trust these reviewed native sources and allow the private build/download.
debugger.deleteHelp: Delete this retained profile from the selected project?
